snippet.title: Steam Demo Trailer for Kriegsspiel ~ 7 Years' War
snippet.description:
Play as a General in Kriegsspiel ~ 7 Years' War, a real-time wargame simulating battles from the Seven Years' War (1756-1763). You command different types of regiments: line infantry, field artillery, cavalry, hussars, and more.
Your control over your troops is limited: you depend on couriers to transmit your orders to these regiments. Your regiments will also send you couriers, to keep you informed of the situation beyond your field of vision. Furthermore, you must pay attention to the terrain, supplies, and the condition of your troops.

But these constraints also apply to your opponents: you can use them to your advantage!

You may download the work-in-progress demo or wishlist this game on : 
- Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4203630/Kriegsspiel__7_Years_War/
- Itchio : https://franzoar.itch.io/kriegsspiel-7-years-war

You are gladly welcome to share your thoughts, write remarks or contact me on :
- Discord : https://discord.gg/G73PTUYYTs
- Reddit : https://www.reddit.com/r/kriegsspiel7yw
I try to answer everyone !
  
A big thank to : 
- Thomas Huguet for sound recording, mixing and consulting : https://tomhuguet.wixsite.com/tomhuguet .
- Nicolas Baker, nicolas-baker.com , for the voice.
- cc0.oer-musik.de for the music : Marais, Marin - Les Folies d'Espagne
